scope: Targeted primary-source comparison of native services and optional OCI/gateway deployment. No container installation, service activation or broker operation was performed.
decision: Retain the qualified native Linux/WSL, systemd and Dagu lanes. Select a container trial only for a demonstrated packaging, isolation or deployment requirement.

candidates.name: Docker Engine / Moby
candidates.rationale: Useful when an upstream image or reproducible OCI deployment closes a dependency/runtime gap. No matched result shows better reproduction or recovery than the accepted native services for this workload.

candidates.name: Docker Compose
candidates.rationale: Declarative multi-service packaging is useful once an OCI workload is selected. Its lifecycle value has not been compared with current service coordination; evaluate it with the chosen engine rather than as another default scheduler.

candidates.name: Podman / Quadlet
candidates.rationale: A maintained rootless OCI challenger with systemd-oriented Quadlet management. Image, networking, volume, GPU and Docker-API compatibility remain workload-specific and unmeasured here.

candidates.name: Dockerized IB Gateway
candidates.rationale: The selected Nautilus source supports optional DockerizedIBGateway alongside an external native TWS/Gateway. Image digest, sign-in, restart, API connectivity and broker reconciliation are not qualified; this is independent of Alpaca acceptance.

comparison_required: Compare the same locked application and database workload under native services and one chosen container lane. Measure installation, startup/rebuild, resources, persistent-state backup/restore, interruption and cleanup against frozen acceptance. Add GPU/broker cases only for that selected workload.
practice: Record resolved image digests and locked application dependencies; keep controlled updates and rollback.
Use build/runtime separation and least-required access appropriate to the selected image and workload.
Keep secrets outside images, source control, prompts and public receipts; native sign-in remains host-specific.
Use Linux-filesystem mounts and explicit resource bounds on WSL; choose one intended engine integration instead of conflicting Desktop and independent WSL installations.
Qualify persistent volumes, health/readiness, networking and recovery; running a container or passing a help command is not acceptance.

Start Nautilus DockerizedIBGateway separately and pass its host/port to clients; the selected docs reject dockerized_gateway in client config. Resolve the mutable stable image to a recorded digest for a trial.
limits: Primary source review is not a container or production-hosting trial.
Apple Container evidence is platform-specific and does not qualify Docker or Podman on Linux.
Containers do not keep a stopped WSL VM running or establish independent host-loss recovery.
No matched result establishes universal runtime or hosting superiority.
